integrity: Explicit analytical proof of Laplace identity, injective exponential mixture and sharp attachment-count threshold; finite and Monte Carlo tests are supporting checks only. Historical priority provisional.
limitations: Classification requires fixed circle circumference, number of sites, and identical common rooted finite metric tree; no noisy-data stability or arbitrary metric-graph reconstruction. Circular Z-related witness predates the theorem.
title: Homometric circle grafts: exact distance-law inversion and sharp four-site nonrigidity
